text: This truth from long experience I assert, that he who has the most friends and the fewest enemies, is the strongest; will rise the highest with the least envy; and fall, if he does fall, the gentlest, and the most pitied.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLXXXI, to his son, Bath, November 11, Old Style 1752
